report.summary: All three UI tests fail at the same step: page.goto(

causes.title: GET /books has a random 0-8 s server-side delay that exceeds the 5 s Playwright timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. render_books() calls list_books() on every /books page render, so each goto('/books') takes a random 0-8 s to get a response. The UI fixture sets a 5000 ms default timeout, and goto waits for the 'load' event, so any request whose delay is above about 5 s times out (roughly 3 in 8 requests). The same code can pass on a rerun, so this is flaky, not a product bug. The product's app code is not designed to be slow here, so the delay should be removed or made deterministic.
evidence: Failure text for all three tests: playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:49185/books", waiting until "load"
Note: the CI log does not include elapsed times, so the link between the random delay and the timeout is inferred from the code, not measured.
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep from list_books in app/main.py (it has no purpose in production code). If the delay is intentional for a test, put it behind an environment flag that tests do not enable, or make it a fixed value. As a short-term workaround, raise the goto timeout only for the books page in tests/support/pages.py, but that hides the slow path rather than fixing it.
